Other News

I am putting the game on a winter discount sale for Xmas This will be at 40% off for 2 weeks. Starting 19th i think. 

Like Always join my discord to be up to date with the very lastest news and that is always the best way to contact me for bug that you find on the game and of cause you input and ideas you would like to put forward for the game DEAD.

Many thanks.

notes.title: Update 3.2
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes 

[olist]
 Host Hearing Client Sounds. 
 Weapon Not un-equipping has been fixed.
 You can no longer end up holding two weapons.
 You can no longer change weapon while swimming.
 While Swimming weapon no longer floats above head.
 After opening barrel loot the inventory slots now disappears property and no longer overlaps craft items.
 Campfire has been changed so that only owner can Turn on or off. (might change this at some point.) 
 Dragging item from campfire inventory to your own has now been fixed.
 Changes have been made to the stamina you should no longer be able to keep sprinting with 0 stamina.
 Client can now hear the creatures with directional hearing.
 Plus some other optimizations.
[/olist]




Content Added

Taming is half complete right now, but will be finished soon and will be in the following update after this one.

Male Deer (Stag) has been added back into the game. This Creature will run from you not attack.

Sorry there wasn't as much added today time was again me tonight.

notes.title: Big Update Patch 2.0
notes.notes:
Important

There was a issue with structures and items duplicating on load game. I have solved the problem but this means that you will have to restart or pick up all the items (Continue To Click Pick up un-till all the items have gone which will give you them into your inventory but this is a pain and takes a long time). You must do one or you will start to experience lag when you continue building on your base at some point.


Story Mode 


 Episode 1 has been add. This is two cut scenes showing two characters going to the island. This tells you a bit more about why you are there and why you are surviving. 



 The characters now have clothes on that they will persist though out the game instead of the player crafting clothes.



 Tutorial is also part the the story mode at the beginning. This will help you understand how to learn craft items and the inventory interface.


Added Items

Metal Knife
Anvil
Stone Well ( This has no inventory yet )
Small Wood Storage Box
Level up Sound

Changes

Day And Night Cycle
Rain SFX Volume
Rain Duration
Thirst Drain 
Texture to Thatch
Character Names
Character Clothes
Knife Attack Animation
You can now Open Stag Inventory Without Riding ( Press E )
 



Bug Fixes


 Split Stack while Riding Deer Stag



 Wood Water Tank Is now filling up with water when it rains. This will give you 3 full refills of thirst.



 Forge Inventory has been fixed you can now put your items in the slot. You can melt Raw Metal to Metal Ingots and melt Skin down to Oil.




 Campfire Fire Light has been changed so it doesn't go out when you are not looking at the fire. 



 Foundation placing will de-spawn all foliage around them. This will also stop foliage spawning back into your base on load game.



 Placing Build items Has been changed so they are easier to place down. build item can now only be placed on landscape, Foundations and Roofs.



 Building System in general has had a lot of updates to make building more smooth for the player.



 Camera Clipping has been turn off.

notes.title: Patch Notes Verson 1.3
notes.notes:
Building system 
This has been updated to fix the problem with build structures snapping in place. However, doors still do not place or snap properly. I am working on that and will have that fixed soon.

Tames
I have added some code that should stop the deer's multiplying when you load the game.

When you first tame a deer you should now been able to access its inventory with out having to quit and reload the game. 

Player 
The player starts have been updated so the damage wont reset on load game. Also your XP does not reset now.

Day And Night Cycle
This has been twicked a little bit so the cycle is faster.

Build Items
You can now pick up Campfires, Thatch Walls. This list will get longer with every update.

You will have to start a new game to reset the spawns and implement these updates.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Updates have been made to the inventory.

 1) you can now attach Armour to you player and you can see you player in a 3D widget on the inventory.

 2) Main objectives and secondary objectives have been add you can view the list in the inventory by clicking the Objectives Tab.

 2a) You will gain XP from completing any objective.

 2b) When you complete an objective a sound will play and text will show up in the top right hand corner of you screen. This will tell you which objective you have completed and how much XP you gained.

notes.title: Settings And Update
notes.notes:
Setting have now been implemented.

DEAD Has pass all the reviews from Steam/Valve so can now be released at any point. I have however chosen August 19th to set the release date. this will give me time to get more things ready.

The has gone through some beta testing over the last few days. This has been great as i have been able to fix some issues that i had missed. 

More work has gone into the map, also more optimization as been done. Specifically with the inventory. When open with lots of Craft Items learnt, this was causing a drop in the frame rate. This has now been dealt with.

notes.title: Friday Update!
notes.notes:
Friday Update!

The save system is now fully functioning and is running perfectly.

More exciting content has been added this week. 

I am now at the stage where I will be able to release a few Steam keys. This will likely be in the next 4 weeks. Thus meaning, that you will likely see the gameplay footage on youtube and also on twitch.
